Use the data API to create two EnhancedLetterhead records with distinct synthetic names and nonempty LetterheadHeader. Sort their IDs. Create three EmailTemplate records in a scratch-user folder with distinct Name and DeveloperName values, TemplateType=custom, UiType=SFX and Encoding=UTF-8, with EnhancedLetterheadId null, lower and higher respectively. Re-query all three references and identify records as N, L, H. At each API version query them with ORDER BY EnhancedLetterheadId NULLS FIRST, NULLS LAST, ASC, DESC, and DESC NULLS LAST. No email is sent.
